## Cold open

> SCENE (states): Sachsen-Anhalt lights up on the map of Germany.
> Sachsen-Anhalt | Landeshauptstadt Magdeburg

[dramatic] [[Sachsen-Anhalt]], Saxony-Anhalt, lies in the middle of eastern Germany. Its capital is Magdeburg. In Wittenberg, Martin Luther started the Reformation in 1517, and in Dessau the Bauhaus, the famous school of design, built its home.

[dramatic] If you take the citizenship test in Saxony-Anhalt, three of your thirty-three questions are about the state you live in. They come from a list of just ten. Here are all ten, with the answers.

> SCENE (title): Title card.
> SACHSEN-ANHALT

## On the map

{Q438}

> SCENE (question): Question card #438. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows a map with four states, numbered. [[Welches Bundesland ist Sachsen-Anhalt?]] Which federal state is Saxony-Anhalt?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[3]]. Number three: the middle of eastern Germany.


{Q437}

> SCENE (question): Question card #437. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Die Landeshauptstadt von Sachsen-Anhalt heißt …]] The state capital of Saxony-Anhalt is...

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Magdeburg.]] The other three are real cities in Saxony-Anhalt, but not the capital.


## Flag and coat of arms

{Q435}

> SCENE (question): Question card #435. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welche Farben hat die Landesflagge von Sachsen-Anhalt?]] What are the colors of the state flag of Saxony-Anhalt?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[gelb-schwarz]]. Yellow and black, with the coat of arms.


{Q431}

> SCENE (question): Question card #431. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] The exam shows four coats of arms. [[Welches Wappen gehört zum Bundesland Sachsen-Anhalt?]] Which coat of arms belongs to the federal state of Saxony-Anhalt?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Bild 4]], picture four: on top, black and gold stripes with a green band; below, a black bear on a red wall.


## How it's run

{Q432}

> SCENE (question): Question card #432. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Welches ist ein Landkreis in Sachsen-Anhalt?]] Which of these is a district (Landkreis) in Saxony-Anhalt?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Börde]]. The others are elsewhere: [[Ammerland]] is in [[Niedersachsen]], [[Altötting]] is in [[Bayern]], and [[Uckermark]] is in [[Brandenburg]].


{Q433}

> SCENE (question): Question card #433. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Für wie viele Jahre wird der Landtag in Sachsen-Anhalt gewählt?]] For how many years is the Landtag (state parliament) in Saxony-Anhalt elected?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[5]]. Five years, like almost every state parliament.


{Q434}

> SCENE (question): Question card #434. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Ab welchem Alter darf man in Sachsen-Anhalt bei Kommunalwahlen wählen?]] At what age are you allowed to vote in local elections in Saxony-Anhalt?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[16]]. Here, you can vote in local elections from sixteen. It differs from state to state. For the Bundestag, it's eighteen everywhere.


{Q439}

> SCENE (question): Question card #439. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] [[Wie nennt man die Regierungschefin oder den Regierungschef in Sachsen-Anhalt?]] What is the head of government in Saxony-Anhalt called?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Ministerpräsidentin oder Ministerpräsident]], the minister-president. Not a prime minister, and not a mayor: mayors run towns and cities.


{Q440}

> SCENE (question): Question card #440. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.
> @ Außenministerin oder Außenminister

[dramatic] And a question with a [[nicht]]. [[Welche Ministerin oder welchen Minister hat Sachsen-Anhalt nicht?]] Which minister does Saxony-Anhalt not have?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[Außenministerin oder Außenminister]], a foreign minister. Foreign policy is the federation's job, so no state has one. Finance, justice and the interior: every state has those.


{Q436}

> SCENE (question): Question card #436. Three seconds to guess, then the answer highlights.

[dramatic] [[Wo können Sie sich in Sachsen-Anhalt über politische Themen informieren?]] Where can you find information on political topics in Saxony-Anhalt?

[countdown] [dramatic] [[bei der Landeszentrale für politische Bildung]], the state centre for civic education. Every state has one. It's free, it belongs to no party, and it has material on politics in plain language.


## What to remember for the exam

> SCENE (words): The words appear one by one, then settle into a grid.
> Magdeburg, gelb-schwarz, Ministerpräsident

[dramatic] Three answers to hold on to: [[Magdeburg]]. [[gelb-schwarz]]. And [[Ministerpräsident]].
